# Figure and table list (generated by scripts from results/; fixed method style across figures)

Regenerate everything: `make -C paper all` (numbers -> tables -> figures). Every figure has `fig*.meta.json` (data files, commit, script).

| ID | Content | Script | Data | In text |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fig. paired | Paired return difference of the validation-selected v3 PPO to the best constant per regime, confirmatory seeds 60000+ (box + all points + median CI + mean) | `paper/figures.py::fig_paired` | `results/controller_comparison_v3_fresh/per_episode.csv` | 6.2 |
| Fig. headroom | Headroom captured per training seed (oracle = 100 %), confirmatory seeds | `fig_headroom` | same | 6.3 |
| Fig. curves | v2 evaluation return per seed (peak then degradation) beside v3 validation curves with the selected checkpoints | `fig_curves` | `rl/policies/ppo_v2/seed_*/evaluations.npz`, `rl/policies/ppo_v3/seed_*/val_curve.json` | 6.1 |
| Fig. algos | v4 PPO/SAC/TD3 paired differences per regime (box + points + mean), seeds 70000+ | `fig_algos` | `results/controller_comparison_v4_{ppo,sac,td3}/per_episode.csv` | 6.5 |
| Fig. paired_expl (supplement) | Same as Fig. paired on the exploratory seeds 50000+ | `fig_paired` | `results/controller_comparison_v3/per_episode.csv` | supplement |

| Table main_conf | Confirmatory result: mean ± SD return, median Δ [CI], mean Δ [CI], IQR of Δ, Holm p, success (descriptive), per regime and controller | `paper/tables.py` | `.../controller_comparison_v3_fresh/per_episode.csv` | 6.2 |
| Table main_expl (supplement) | Same on the exploratory seeds | `tables.py` | `.../controller_comparison_v3/per_episode.csv` | supplement |
| Table infeasible | Mean return on infeasible scenarios per controller and regime (separate from the headline) | `tables.py` | confirmatory CSV | 6.4 |
| Table v2 | v2 per-seed peak, final, drop, and share of episodes with Ki / Kp at the maximum | `tables.py` | `.../controller_comparison/per_episode.csv`, `rl/policies/ppo_v2/*/evaluations.npz` | 6.1 |
| Table v4 | PPO/SAC/TD3 (v4): median [CI], mean [CI], IQR, per-seed medians | `tables.py` | v4 CSVs | 6.5 |
| Table hparams | Settings that differ between v2, v3 and v4, plus the reward weights | `tables.py` | `rl/ppo*.yaml`, `config/motor_parameters.yaml` | 4, supplement |

## Not yet made (candidates, add or drop with you)
- Per-context breakdown (no payload / payload no gravity / payload + gravity) of the paired differences.
- Twin figures (block diagram, fixed-PID test sequence, datasheet inconsistency, sensitivity, motor zoo): available from the project results; only needed if the paper's scope includes the twin and tuning pipeline contributions (decision needed).
- Hardware figures (rig, identification, validation): none; no hardware data.

## Rules applied
One fixed colour, marker and line style per method; no titles inside figures; axes labelled with quantity; box plots show all points; captions state sample size, seed set and "simulation". Vector PDF plus 300 dpi PNG. Figures are sized for one (3.5 in) or two (7.2 in) columns.
